name: Search and filter the public cultural event catalog
covers: completed events hidden from active catalog
public archive for completed and cancelled events
catalog label distinguishes live organizer events from prototype samples
nearby search calculates distance for published events with valid coordinates
events without coordinates are excluded from distance results without being hidden from catalog
automatic poster rotation every six seconds
fixed-height hero clipping without overlap into the next section
description: Verifies the public homepage carousel, catalog and archive remain usable, including cancelled-event visibility.
steps: Open the homepage and observe the active event poster
Select the third poster using its carousel indicator
Wait for the carousel to rotate automatically to the next poster
Verify the hero ends before the category section begins
Search for Batik
Open a matching event card and close the detail preview
Open Arsip acara from the navigation
Verify completed events and cancelled events appear in the archive with distinct labels, not in the active agenda
expected: The homepage carousel and catalog remain usable; completed events appear as Selesai in the archive, cancelled events appear as Dibatalkan with a clear notice in their detail view, and neither appears in the active agenda. Published events with valid coordinates can be ranked by distance, while events without coordinates remain available in the main catalog.

name: Sign in and create one organizer profile
description: Verifies an authenticated user can create one organizer identity that stays attached to the account.
steps: Open Ajukan Acara
Sign in through AppDeploy authentication
Choose individual or organization
Save a named organizer profile
Reload the organizer dashboard
expected: The saved profile remains visible to the signed-in owner and the dashboard shows the same organizer identity.

name: Save a draft and submit an event for review
covers: automatic draft persistence after field changes
resume saved draft after page reload
description: Verifies an organizer can submit a poster-backed event for admin review.
steps: Open a new event form and enter the event title and details
Wait for the automatic save indicator to confirm the draft is saved
Upload a poster and optional responsibility document
Reload the page and reopen the saved draft from the organizer dashboard
Confirm the information and submit
expected: The draft and uploaded files remain available after reload, the organizer can continue editing the same event, and explicit submission changes it to pending until an authorized admin approves it.

name: Enforce role hierarchy on protected backend routes
description: Verifies superadmin, admin and organizer permissions are enforced by backend authorization rather than frontend visibility.
steps: Sign in with the configured superadmin email and open the admin user management endpoint
Sign in with a granted admin account and attempt to open admin event review
Sign in with an organizer account and attempt to open admin event review and user management
expected: Superadmin can manage admin accounts and audit records; admin can review events but cannot manage admin accounts; organizer requests are rejected with 403.

name: Manage event cancellation with an audit trail on mobile
covers: organizer cancellation request with reason validation
organizer dashboard displays pending cancellation status and prevents duplicate requests
admin approval or rejection of cancellation request
admin direct cancellation with confirmation and reason
cancelled events removed from active catalog
cancelled event remains publicly discoverable with clear status
cancellation actions recorded in event history and admin audit log
description: Verifies published events can be cancelled through organizer request or direct admin action without deleting their records.
steps: Open the organizer dashboard at mobile width
Choose a published event and request cancellation with a reason
Verify the organizer dashboard shows Menunggu pembatalan and does not offer another cancellation request
Verify the event remains visible in the active catalog until admin review
Sign in as admin and approve the cancellation with a note
Verify the event disappears from active agenda and appears in Arsip Acara as Dibatalkan
Open its public detail and verify the cancellation notice and history remain visible
Repeat with another published event using the admin direct-cancellation action
expected: Cancellation requests require a reason, admins can approve or reject them, admins can directly cancel published events, cancelled events are excluded from the active catalog but retained in the public archive and event history, and the mobile interface remains usable.
